verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new PR, but the documented output is bug-finding and suggested fixes, not a summary. Summaries and explanations of what changed come from Graphite Chat, which a reviewer has to prompt on demand (e.g. "Summarize the changes in this PR"). missing for 10: automatic per-PR summary generation without prompting, a structured change walkthrough (e.g. file-by-file), independent or hands-on corroboration.
